title: Al Cooper and a beauty-contest anecdote
summary: Campbell tells about Al Cooper's granddaughter.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So what were you saying about Al Cooper?

Oh, Al Cooper -- I'll tell you, wait a minute, his daughter -- maybe it's his granddaughter won a beauty contest in Cannes, France, a few years ago. I can't think of her first name, but anyway her last name was Cooper. Al Cooper now is into real estate in Florida. He's worth about a half a million dollars.
